data.title: Donald Trump administration: Internal uprising in Iran possible amid pressure campaign | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the pressure on Tehran could lead the Iranian public to rise up against the regime or cause the IRGC to turn against itself.
